title: Beauty Inventory Audit Staleness
dataSources: Closet activity (`style:wardrobe`), cleaning tasks (`style:cleaning`), shoe wears (`style:shoes`), beauty inventory (`beauty:product`), audits (`style:audit`).
app: Wardrobe and beauty telemetry — Stylebook closet exports, dry-cleaning reminders, shoe-rotation logs, and makeup inventory audits — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=style:audit area_name=* last_audit_epoch=* now_epoch=*
| eval lag_days=round((now_epoch-last_audit_epoch)/86400,1)
| stats avg(lag_days) as avg_lag_days, max(lag_days) as worst_lag_days by area_name
| sort - avg_lag_days
description: Measures inventory audit staleness by storage area for beauty-inventory reviews.
value: Lag tracking shows which storage area create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside beauty-inventory reviews.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `inventory audit staleness` on `style:audit` events and aggregate them by `area_name`.
visualization: Table of storage area with average and worst inventory audit staleness.
grandmaExplanation: It frames how long things take for each storage area so you can see where beauty-inventory reviews slows down.
